```{r global, include = FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(htmltools)
library(reactable)

# The data are read from a fixed commit of Prudic et al.'s repository (7 June 2019),
# which was still the head of its master branch on 23 September 2026, so that later
# changes to the repository cannot silently change the dashboard.
bioscan_data_url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jcoliver/bioscan/bbc6b5759ead99ca0c3a29fc8cbe257a992b40e3/data/'

# Read BioScan data in
BioScan = read.csv(paste0(bioscan_data_url, 'BioScanDataComplete.csv'))

#head(BioScan)

# Specify data source
BioScan[,'source'] = 'BioScan'

# There are pseudovariables, that is, observations entered as variables. Since most R processes 
# need the tidy format, convert below (see https://r4ds.had.co.nz/tidy-data.html).
# The counts recorded on Pollard walks and in Malaise traps are preserved.

BioScan = BioScan %>% pivot_longer(
    cols = Anthocharis_sara:Vanessa_cardui, names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Number", values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

# Compare
#str(BioScan)
# 928 rows now; the result of 29 pseudovariables being transposed into
# rows, interacting with 32 previous rows, i.e., 29 * 32 = 928.

#head(BioScan)

BioScan$Species = as.character(BioScan$Species)

# Concatenate latitude and longitude
BioScan$site = paste0(BioScan$Latitude, ', ', BioScan$Longitude)

# Read in iNaturalist data
iNaturalist = read.csv(paste0(bioscan_data_url, 'iNaturalist-clean-reduced.csv'))

#str(iNaturalist)
#head(iNaturalist)

# Specify data source
iNaturalist[,'source'] = 'iNaturalist'

# Concatenate latitude, longitude
iNaturalist$site = paste0(iNaturalist$latitude, ', ', iNaturalist$longitude)

# The iNaturalist data set presents a slightly different challenge from the pseudovariables found above.
# Here Number is the number of observations of each species at each site, computed from repeated entries.

iNaturalist = merge(iNaturalist, iNaturalist %>% count(species, site, name = 'Number'))

# Match column names to BioScan data set

names(iNaturalist)[names(iNaturalist)=='species'] = 'Species'
names(iNaturalist)[names(iNaturalist)=='latitude'] = 'Latitude'
names(iNaturalist)[names(iNaturalist)=='longitude'] = 'Longitude'

# Merge BioScan and iNaturalist data sets
dat = merge(BioScan, iNaturalist, all = TRUE)

# Remove entries with no observations
dat = dat[!dat$Number==0,]
dat$Number = factor(dat$Number)

# Remove empty rows
dat = dat[!is.na(dat$Species),]

# Clarify data collection methods and data sources, as reported in
# Prudic et al. (2018; https://www.mdpi.com/2075-4450/9/4/186/htm).

dat$Method_source = ifelse(dat$Collection.Method == 'Pollard Walk', 'Pollard Walk (BioScan)',
                           ifelse(dat$Collection.Method == 'Malaise', 'Malaise trap (BioScan)', NA))

dat[is.na(dat$Method_source), 'Method_source'] = 'crowdsourcing (iNaturalist)'

# Order based on level of training (see https://www.mdpi.com/2075-4450/9/4/186/htm)
dat$Method_source =  factor(dat$Method_source,
                            levels = c('crowdsourcing (iNaturalist)', 'Pollard Walk (BioScan)',
                                       'Malaise trap (BioScan)'))

# Add wing span (in mm) of each butterfly from Prudic et al.'s data
# (species-data.csv, read from the same fixed commit as above)

wingspan = read.csv(paste0(bioscan_data_url, 'species-data.csv'))

names(wingspan)[names(wingspan)=='species'] = 'Species'

# For simplicity, take average span
wingspan$wingspan_mm = rowMeans(wingspan[,c('opler.wright.min', 'opler.wright.max')])

dat = merge(dat, wingspan[, c('Species', 'wingspan_mm')], all.x = TRUE)

# Count the rows per species and per collection method, across sites. In the two
# BioScan methods, a row is one site (the abundance there is in Number), so these
# are numbers of sites. In iNaturalist, a row is one observation.

dat = merge(dat,
            dat[dat$Method_source=='crowdsourcing (iNaturalist)',] %>%
              count(Species, name = 'N_crowdsourcing_iNaturalist'), all=TRUE)

dat = merge(dat,
            dat[dat$Method_source=='Pollard Walk (BioScan)',] %>%
              count(Species, name = 'N_Pollard_Walk_BioScan'), all=TRUE)

dat = merge(dat,
            dat[dat$Method_source=='Malaise trap (BioScan)',] %>%
              count(Species, name = 'N_malaise_trap_BioScan'), all=TRUE)

# Count all rows per species, i.e., the sum of the three counts above
dat = merge(dat, dat %>% count(Species, name = 'N_per_species'))

# Replace NAs with zeros
dat[is.na(dat$N_crowdsourcing_iNaturalist), 'N_crowdsourcing_iNaturalist'] = 0
dat[is.na(dat$N_Pollard_Walk_BioScan), 'N_Pollard_Walk_BioScan'] = 0
dat[is.na(dat$N_malaise_trap_BioScan), 'N_malaise_trap_BioScan'] = 0
dat[is.na(dat$N_per_species), 'N_per_species'] = 0

# Add four sizes missing from Prudic et al.'s data set (information source shown for each)

dat[dat$Species=='Adelpha_bredowii', 'wingspan_mm'] = '80'  # https://www.butterfliesandmoths.org/species/Adelpha-bredowii
dat[dat$Species=='Icaricia_acmon', 'wingspan_mm'] = '22'  # https://books.google.co.uk/books?id=tJpoXFZBBnAC&pg=PA160&lpg=PA160&dq=Icaricia+Acmon+wingspan&source=bl&ots=fwJmp7NSlL&sig=ACfU3U3-564Ee30EqK8xKC3051_VUbcIhQ&hl=en&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjA8_6avNrnAhUUQkEAHaDfDI8Q6AEwA3oECAkQAQ#v=onepage&q=Icaricia%20Acmon%20wingspan&f=false
dat[dat$Species=='Limenitis_lorquini', 'wingspan_mm'] = '63'  # https://books.google.co.uk/books?id=-8eVW34x-6sC&pg=PP52&lpg=PP52&dq=Adelpha+Bredowii+wingspan&source=bl&ots=gXEHVNcnVd&sig=ACfU3U3T97hlZEslx3r18uQx8GBmTJzr5g&hl=en&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwi9qN6yvNrnAhXOSsAKHd2QCB8Q6AEwC3oECA8QAQ#v=onepage&q=Adelpha%20Bredowii%20wingspan&f=false
dat[dat$Species=='Papilio_rumiko', 'wingspan_mm'] = '165'  # https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papilio_cresphontes

# Specify proper variable class
dat$wingspan_mm = as.numeric(dat$wingspan_mm)

# Image links

dat[dat$Species=='Adelpha_bredowii', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/67/California_Sister_Yosemite.jpg/250px-California_Sister_Yosemite.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Agraulis_vanillae', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/bc/Agraulis_vanillae_butterfly_from_above.JPG/250px-Agraulis_vanillae_butterfly_from_above.JPG'
dat[dat$Species=='Brephidium_exilis', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/4b/Pygmy_blue_%28Brephidium_exilis_thompsoni%29_2.JPG/250px-Pygmy_blue_%28Brephidium_exilis_thompsoni%29_2.JPG'
dat[dat$Species=='Colias_eurytheme', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8d/ColiasEurytheme01.jpg/250px-ColiasEurytheme01.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Danaus_gilippus', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/be/Queen_%28Danaus_gilippus_berenice%29.JPG/250px-Queen_%28Danaus_gilippus_berenice%29.JPG'
dat[dat$Species=='Danaus_plexippus', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/63/Monarch_In_May.jpg/250px-Monarch_In_May.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Erynnis_funeralis', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/56/Erynnis_funeralis_7919.JPG/250px-Erynnis_funeralis_7919.JPG'
dat[dat$Species=='Heliopetes_ericetorum', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/57/Turks-cap_white-skipper_%28Heliopetes_macaira%29_male_%2B_female_dorsal.jpg/250px-Turks-cap_white-skipper_%28Heliopetes_macaira%29_male_%2B_female_dorsal.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Hylephila_phyleus', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/10/Fiery_Skipper_%28Hylephila_phyleus%29_%E2%99%82_%287898971392%29.jpg/250px-Fiery_Skipper_%28Hylephila_phyleus%29_%E2%99%82_%287898971392%29.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Icaricia_acmon', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0a/Plebejus_acmon2.jpg/250px-Plebejus_acmon2.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Junonia_coenia', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2e/Buckeye_Butterfly_%28Junonia_coenia%29.png/250px-Buckeye_Butterfly_%28Junonia_coenia%29.png'
dat[dat$Species=='Leptotes_marina', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/bc/Marine_blue_%28Leptotes_marina%29.jpg/250px-Marine_blue_%28Leptotes_marina%29.jpg'

dat[dat$Species=='Limenitis_lorquini', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/a/a4/Lorquinsadmiral2.jpg/250px-Lorquinsadmiral2.jpg'
dat[dat$Species=='Nathalis_iole', 'image_link'] = 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/0d/SULPHUR%2C_DAINTY_%28Nathalis_iole%29_%289-2-10%29_patagonia_hills%2C_scc%2C_az_%282%29_%289421556707%29.jpg/250px-SULPHUR%2C_DAINTY_%28Nathalis_iole%29_%289-2-10%29_patagonia_hills%2C_scc%2C_az_%282%29_%289421556707%29.jpg'

  'Vanessa_atalanta', 'Andrew Curtis', 'CC BY-SA 2.0', NA,
    'https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_Admiral_(Vanessa_atalanta)_on_ivy_-_geograph.org.uk_-_1519665.jpg',
  'Vanessa_cardui', 'Jean-Pol GRANDMONT', 'CC BY 3.0', NA,
    'https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:0_Belle-dame_(Vanessa_cardui)_-_Echinacea_purpurea_-_Havr%C3%A9_(3).jpg'
)

stopifnot(all(dat$Species %in% image_credits$Species))

related_note = ifelse(is.na(image_credits$related_shown), '',
                      paste0('; related species shown: <i>', image_credits$related_shown, '</i>'))

# Credits for the map, in one line
image_credits$image_licence_map = paste0("<a target='_top' href='", image_credits$file_page, "'>",
                                         image_credits$author, ' (', image_credits$licence, ')</a>',
                                         related_note)

# Credits for the table, over several lines
image_credits$image_licence_table = paste0('<a target="_blank" href="', image_credits$file_page, '">',
                                           image_credits$author, '<br>(', image_credits$licence, ')</a>',
                                           ifelse(is.na(image_credits$related_shown), '',
                                                  paste0('<br>Related species shown: <i>',
                                                         image_credits$related_shown, '</i>')))

credit_row = match(dat$Species, image_credits$Species)
dat$image_licence_map = image_credits$image_licence_map[credit_row]
dat$image_licence_table = image_credits$image_licence_table[credit_row]

```

### <span style='font-size: 16px; padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; display: inline-block;'> <a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/BioScan/blob/master/data/BioScanDataComplete.csv' target='_top'> Open data</a> (<a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/bioscan/blob/master/data/iNaturalist-clean-reduced.csv' target='_top'>iNaturalist</a> and <a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/bioscan/blob/master/data/BioScanDataComplete.csv' target='_top'>BioScan</a>) from Prudic, K.L.; Oliver, J.C.; Brown, B.V.; Long, E.C. <a href='https://doi.org/10.3390/insects9040186' target='_top'> **Comparisons of Citizen Science Data-Gathering Approaches to Evaluate Urban Butterfly Diversity**. *Insects* **2018**, *9*, 186</a>. Dashboard independently developed by <a href='https://github.com/pablobernabeu/Data-is-present/blob/master/README.md' target='_top'>Pablo Bernabeu</a>. Searchable <a href='https://www.openstreetmap.org/' target='_top'>OSM</a> map (desktop computer recommended).</span> {style="text-align:justify; margin-top:4px; padding-top:15px; padding-bottom: 5px;"}

```{r}

# Create image linked to the corresponding Wikimedia Commons file
dat$image_with_hyperlink = paste0("<a target='_top' href=", dat$image_link, "><img style='display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-height:150px;' src='",
                             dat$image_link, "' alt='", gsub("_", " ", dat$Species), "'></a>")

# Format species into hyperlink
dat$Species_hyperlink = paste0("<span style='font-size:16px;'><a href='https://www.google.com/search?q=",
                               gsub('_', '+', dat$Species), "+butterfly' style='text-decoration: none;' target='_top'>",
                               gsub('_', ' ', dat$Species), '</a></span>')

# Combine the Wikimedia Commons image, species name, count and image credit into the pop-ups
dat$map_popup = paste0(dat$image_with_hyperlink, '<br>', dat$Species_hyperlink, ". <i>n</i> = ", dat$Number, ' at this site. Sampling: ', dat$Method_source, ". <a href='https://www.google.com/search?q=", gsub('_', '+', dat$Species), "+butterfly' target='_top'>Search further</a>. Image licence: ", dat$image_licence_map, ".")

# Since animals observed through different methods and sources may overlap in the same spot,
# jitter coordinates a bit. The seed keeps the markers in the same places on every render.

set.seed(2020)
dat$Latitude <- jitter(dat$Latitude, factor = 2250)
dat$Longitude <- jitter(dat$Longitude, factor = 2250)

# Assign different colours depending on origin of samples (https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/markers.html)

dat$icons = NA

dat[dat$Method_source == 'crowdsourcing (iNaturalist)', 'icons'] =
  'https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-green.png'

dat[dat$Method_source == 'Pollard Walk (BioScan)', 'icons'] =
  'https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-orange.png'

dat[dat$Method_source == 'Malaise trap (BioScan)', 'icons'] =
  'https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-red.png'

leafIcons <- icons(iconUrl = dat$icons,
  iconWidth = 38, iconHeight = 95, iconAnchorX = 22, iconAnchorY = 94,
  shadowUrl = 'https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-shadow.png',
  shadowWidth = 50, shadowHeight = 64, shadowAnchorX = 4, shadowAnchorY = 62 )

# Create legend (credit: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/37862467/leaflet-legend-for-custom-markers-in-r)
html_legend = "<p style='font-size=18px; text-align:center; border-bottom:1px solid #CFCFCF;'><b>Collection method and source</b></p> &nbsp; &nbsp; <img width=4% src='https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-green.png'/> &nbsp; &nbsp; <span style='font-size=21px;'> Crowd-sourced contributions - <a target='_top' target='_top' href='https://www.inaturalist.org/'>iNaturalist</span></a> <br> &nbsp; &nbsp; <img width=4% src='https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-orange.png'/> &nbsp; &nbsp; <span style='font-size=21px;'> Trained Pollard Walk observations - <a target='_top' href='https://www.mdpi.com/2075-4450/9/4/186/htm'>BioScan</span></a> <br> &nbsp; &nbsp; <img width=4% src='https://leafletjs.com/examples/custom-icons/leaf-red.png'/> &nbsp; &nbsp; <span style='font-size=21px;'> Expert Malaise trap identification - <a target='_top' href='https://www.mdpi.com/2075-4450/9/4/186/htm'>BioScan</span></a> "

leaflet(dat) %>% addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(~Longitude, ~Latitude, icon = leafIcons,
             label = ~as.character(paste(dat$Number, gsub('_', ' ', dat$Species))),
             popup = ~as.character(dat$map_popup),
             labelOptions = labelOptions(style = list("font-size" = "16px"))) %>%
  addControl(html = html_legend, position = "bottomright") %>%
  addResetMapButton() %>% addSearchOSM

```

### <span style='font-size: 16px; padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; display: inline-block;'> <a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/BioScan/blob/master/data/BioScanDataComplete.csv' target="_blank"> Open data</a> (<a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/bioscan/blob/master/data/iNaturalist-clean-reduced.csv' target="_blank">iNaturalist</a> and <a href='https://github.com/jcoliver/bioscan/blob/master/data/BioScanDataComplete.csv' target="_blank">BioScan</a>) from Prudic, K.L.; Oliver, J.C.; Brown, B.V.; Long, E.C. <a href='https://doi.org/10.3390/insects9040186' target="_blank"> **Comparisons of Citizen Science Data-Gathering Approaches to Evaluate Urban Butterfly Diversity**. *Insects* **2018**, *9*, 186</a>. Dashboard independently developed by <a href='https://github.com/pablobernabeu/Data-is-present/blob/master/README.md' target="_blank">Pablo Bernabeu</a>.</span> {style="text-align:justify; margin-top:4px; padding-top:15px; padding-bottom: 5px;"}

```{r}

# Format image
dat$image_with_hyperlink = paste0('<a target="_blank" href=', dat$image_link, '><img style="max-width:350px; width:100%;" src="',
                             dat$image_link, '" alt="', gsub('_', ' ', dat$Species), '"></a>')

# Format text

dat$Species_hyperlink = paste0('<span style="font-size:21px;"><a href="https://www.google.com/search?q=',
                                                       gsub('_', '+', dat$Species),
                                                       '+butterfly" style="text-decoration: none;" target="_blank">',
                                                       gsub('_', ' ', dat$Species), '</a></span>')
dat$image_licence_table = paste0('<span style="font-size:15px;">', dat$image_licence_table, '</span>')

# Aggregate data by variables to be shown on table

species_dat = dat %>% group_by(image_with_hyperlink, Species = Species_hyperlink, wingspan_mm, N_crowdsourcing_iNaturalist,  
                               N_Pollard_Walk_BioScan, N_malaise_trap_BioScan, N_per_species, image_licence_table) %>%
  dplyr::count()

# Create function to have tooltips on column titles (from https://glin.github.io/reactable/articles/cookbook/cookbook.html)
with_tooltip <- function(value, tooltip) {
  span(style = 'text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dotted;', title = tooltip, value)
}

reactable(species_dat[-9],  # Drop the ninth column, `n`, added by `dplyr::count()` above
          defaultColDef = colDef(html = TRUE), defaultSorted = list(Species = 'asc'), striped = TRUE,
          style = list(fontFamily = 'Work Sans, sans-serif', fontSize = '16px'),
          pagination = FALSE, highlight = TRUE, height = 840, fullWidth = TRUE,
          columns = list(
            image_with_hyperlink = colDef(name = ' ', minWidth = 360, filterable = FALSE, sortable = FALSE, html = TRUE),
            Species = colDef(minWidth = 220, filterable = TRUE, html = TRUE),
            image_licence_table = colDef(name = 'Image licence', minWidth = 210, filterable = TRUE, html = TRUE),
            wingspan_mm = colDef(minWidth = 150, header = with_tooltip('Wingspan (mm)', 'Average wingspan in millimetres')),
            N_crowdsourcing_iNaturalist = colDef(minWidth = 155,
                                                 header = with_tooltip('N crowdsourcing',
                                                                                       'Number of crowd-sourced observations (iNaturalist)')),
            N_Pollard_Walk_BioScan = colDef(header = with_tooltip('N trained',
                                                                  'Number of sites where trained observers recorded the species on Pollard Walks (BioScan)')),
            N_malaise_trap_BioScan = colDef(header = with_tooltip('N experts',
                                                                  'Number of sites where experts identified the species in Malaise traps (BioScan)')),
            N_per_species = colDef(name = 'N total', minWidth = 70,
                                   header = with_tooltip('N total',
                                                         'Sum of the three previous columns: iNaturalist observations plus BioScan sites from both methods'))
          ))

```
